name: vscode-codeurjc-slidev
description: Editor support for codeurjc-slidev-theme's custom slides.md grammar: marker/anchor decorations, hovers, diagnostics, reverse code references, and per-slide geometry checking, completion and live preview inspection.

commands.title: CodeURJC Slidev: Copy Selector for Selection
CodeURJC Slidev: Paste Selector into Import
CodeURJC Slidev: Inspect Geometry in Preview

codeurjcSlidev.stepBadges.showTotal.markdownDescription: Show the slide's total clicks in click-step badges (`▸2 of 3` instead of `▸2`). The total is left out on slides whose clicks can't be counted from the markdown.

codeurjcSlidev.devServer.url.markdownDescription: The Slidev dev server **Inspect Geometry in Preview** attaches to. The preview itself is whichever one you have open: the Slidev extension's, or a browser tab.

codeurjcSlidev.geometry.saveOnDrag.markdownDescription: Save the deck after applying an element dragged in the preview, so the preview shows the result. Saving saves the whole file: pending edits elsewhere in it are saved too, and any format-on-save runs. When off, drags are applied to the editor and left unsaved.

codeurjcSlidev.deckDiscovery.enabled.markdownDescription: Find this workspace's slide decks: offer to register the ones the Slidev extension doesn't know yet in its `slidev.include` setting, and show a tip about switching decks the first time a deck of a multi-deck project is opened.

scripts.vsix: node esbuild.js --production && pnpm dlx @vscode/vsce@4 package --no-dependencies --skip-license --out vscode-codeurjc-slidev.vsix
